column1: Total revenue is 2,321,963 with profit 465,935 (overall margin 20.1%) from 5,872 order lines.
Revenue grew 16.2% in 2024 and 11.1% in 2025 - steady growth.
Technology is the top category by revenue (48.7% of sales); Office Supplies has the best margin (43.3%).
Furniture has the weakest margin (1.9%) - discounting is hurting it.
West is the top region (32.2% of revenue); South has the lowest margin (17.4%) because of heavier discounts.
Seasonality: Oct-Dec (Q4) brings 33.8% of yearly revenue; best month is December, weakest is January.
Top 3 products (Laptop, Smartphone, Printer Ink) give 48.6% of revenue.
Orders with 20%+ discount earn only 0.2% margin vs 29.4% with no discount.
Furniture sold at 20%+ discount is loss-making (profit -33,475).
